extracted.name: Jalapeno Popper Cups
extracted.description: Mini phyllo cups filled with a creamy, cheesy jalapeno filling are a more sophisticated version of the jalapeno popper.
instruction_lines: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Place phyllo cups onto a baking sheet.

Stir together cream cheese, Cheddar cheese, jalapenos, and hot sauce in a bowl. Spoon mixture into phyllo cups. Sprinkle bacon bits on top. Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, about 15 to 20 minutes. Serve warm.
